a: अभी — [अभि-इ] {c2c} P. 1 To approach, come or draw near, go up to (with acc.) अस्मानत्तुमितोऽभ्येति Bk. 7. 84.; Ki. 2. 54. --2 To go along or after, follow, serve. --3 (a) To go into, enter; Bk. 5. 67; Ms. 8. 75. (b) To go over to, reach, arrive at; Me. 34 v. l. (c) To fall to one's share, come to; Bk. 7. 99. --4 To get, meet with, fall into, suffer, undergo (said of good or bad things); कार्यं संसिद्धिमभ्येति Pt. 1.

a: अभीक — a. [For ety. see अभिक] 1 Longing after, desirous, anxious. --2 Lustful, libidinous, voluptuous; मेदस्विनः सरभसोपगतानभीकान् Śi. 5. 64. --3 Fearless. --4 Gone to (अभिगत). --5 Dreadful. --कः 1 A lover, husband. --2 A poet. --3 A master. --कं Ved. 1 Proximity, nearness. --2 Collision; combat, encounter, opposition. The form अभीके frequently occurs in the Vedas in the sense of (a) near; (b) at the same time or place, at the right time, just in time; (c) in a moment, instantaneously, or (used like a preposition with abl.), (d) from, out of; (e) on account of, with regard to; (f.) from.
